title: deadset edges document
description: The cross-language edges of one target, deadset-edges.json at the target root: each a declared pair of stable symbol references, provides existing because used_by uses it, as contract/grammar/merge.md states, written under the edge's identifier, so one identifier names one edge. A maintainer or a code generator writes the document and nothing infers an edge. The document is strict JSON with a closed key list at every level: a key this schema does not declare, a key written twice in one object, an edge identifier among them, a value of a type it does not admit, null included, and a value outside its form are refused, and the run ends with the usage code before any analysis. A document larger than the x-max-bytes of contract/config.schema.json is refused the same way before it is read whole, and a document name resolving outside the target root or to anything but a regular file ends the run with the failure code, nothing read from it. An absent document declares no edge.

description.description: What a file header comment would have carried; no analysis reads it.

edges.description: The declared edges, each under its identifier, which every evaluation of the edge names. May be empty.

additionalProperties.description: One edge, its sides and why it exists.

because.description: Why the pair exists, for whoever reads the document next; no analysis reads it.

provides.description: The stable symbol reference of the symbol the other side uses.

used_by.description: The stable symbol reference of the symbol that uses it.

reference.description: One side of an edge: a stable symbol reference naming exactly one symbol, a language tag, ://, a scope, # and a fragment, with no whitespace. A reference admits no wildcard: a * outside a quoted component and a computed key makes it name more than one symbol. A reference in this shape that the language's grammar does not define names no symbol, and its side evaluates absent rather than ending the run.
